title: BetaManagedAgentsMemoryStoreResource
description: A memory store attached to an agent session.

memory_store_id.description: The memory store ID (memstore_...). Must belong to the caller's organization and workspace.

access.description: Access mode for the mounted store. Defaults to `read_write`. `read_only` mounts the store as a read-only filesystem.

name.description: Display name of the memory store, snapshotted at attach time. Later edits to the store's name do not propagate to this resource.

description.description: Description of the memory store, snapshotted at attach time. Rendered into the agent's system prompt. Empty string when the store has no description.

instructions.description: Per-attachment guidance for the agent on how to use this store. Rendered into the memory section of the system prompt. Max 4096 chars.

mount_path.description: Filesystem path where the store is mounted in the session container, e.g. /mnt/memory/user-preferences. Derived from the store's name. Output-only.
